requirements.text: Availability to work full-time starting January 11, 2027 – May 7, 2027, at our headquarters in Palo Alto, CA.
Pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science or a closely related field.
Expected graduation date in December 2027 or Spring 2028.
Proficiency in one or more industry-standard programming languages (e.g., Java, Go, Python, C++, Objective-C, JavaScript).
Familiarity with fundamental computer science concepts, such as algorithms, data structures, operating systems, concurrency, and distributed systems.
Hands-on software engineering experience through internships, competitive coding challenges, significant academic projects, or research publications.
